constraints.description: Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
All proposals are expected to incorporate mechanisms for assessing and demonstrating progress, including qualitative and quantitative KPIs, benchmarking, and progress monitoring.
When possible, proposals should build on and reuse public results from relevant previous funded actions.
Communicable results should be shared with the European R&D community through the AI-on-demand platform.
Projects selected in this topic should link to the resources offered by the AI Factories, including the Data Labs.

This topic implements the co-programmed European Partnership on AI, data, and robotics (ADRA), and all proposals are expected to allocate tasks for cohesion activities with ADRA and the CSA HORIZON-CL4-2025-03-HUMAN-18: GenAI4EU central Hub.
Maximum EU contribution per project is fixed at €19,000,000. Both the minimum and maximum contributions are set at €19,000,000.

constraints.assumption_note: The 48-month maximum duration is recorded in selected_call.json accompanied by the note that it is not explicitly stated in the topic text and reflects the standard maximum for large RIA actions under Horizon Europe. Verification against General Annex B is required before treating this as a binding constraint.

constraints.description: Participation is limited to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded unless guarantees are provided.

To ensure portfolio coverage, grants will be awarded not only in order of ranking, but also to at least one proposal focusing on each of the three sectors: healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and in-vehicle autonomous driving — subject to proposals passing all evaluation thresholds.
Financial support to third parties (FSTP) is applicable. Maximum FSTP per grant at stage 2: €300,000; at stage 3: €2,250,000; maximum per third party: €2,550,000.
Proposals should build on or seek collaboration with relevant projects and develop synergies with other relevant International, European, national, or regional initiatives.
